headline: Exchange Inflows Fell To 282.8 Million Dollars As Bitstamp Took In 409.7 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 282.8 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.1042 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, down from 346.8 million dollars and 0.1277 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means that money arrived where holders can sell, and the smaller print means that arrival slowed. Bitstamp took in 409.7 million dollars and Binance took in 127.0 million, while Bitfinex shed 233.8 million and Bybit shed 92.4 million.
author: jordan
